mapper.select: SELECT pl.id, pl.uuid, pl.project_id AS projectId, pl.list_name AS listName, pl.list_type AS listType, c.customer_name AS customerName, pl.entry_date AS entryDate, pl.pdf_attachment_id AS pdfAttachmentId, pl.create_time AS createTime, pl.create_user AS createUser, pl.update_time AS updateTime, pl.update_user AS updateUser FROM project_list pl LEFT JOIN project_basic_info p ON pl.project_id = p.uuid LEFT JOIN customer_info c ON p.customer_id = c.uuid WHERE pl.uuid = #{uuid}

SELECT pl.id, pl.uuid, pl.project_id AS projectId, pl.list_name AS listName, pl.list_type AS listType, c.customer_name AS customerName, pl.entry_date AS entryDate, pl.pdf_attachment_id AS pdfAttachmentId, pl.create_time AS createTime, pl.create_user AS createUser, pl.update_time AS updateTime, pl.update_user AS updateUser FROM project_list pl LEFT JOIN project_basic_info p ON pl.project_id = p.uuid LEFT JOIN customer_info c ON p.customer_id = c.uuid ORDER BY pl.entry_date DESC, pl.update_time DESC, pl.create_time DESC

SELECT pl.id, pl.uuid, pl.project_id AS projectId, pl.list_name AS listName, pl.list_type AS listType, c.customer_name AS customerName, pl.entry_date AS entryDate, pl.pdf_attachment_id AS pdfAttachmentId, pl.create_time AS createTime, pl.create_user AS createUser, pl.update_time AS updateTime, pl.update_user AS updateUser FROM project_list pl LEFT JOIN project_basic_info p ON pl.project_id = p.uuid LEFT JOIN customer_info c ON p.customer_id = c.uuid WHERE pl.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY pl.entry_date DESC, pl.update_time DESC, pl.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_list ( uuid, project_id, list_name, list_type, entry_date, pdf_attachment_id, create_time, create_user ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, #{projectId}, #{listName}, #{listType}, #{entryDate}, #{pdfAttachmentId}, NOW(), #{createUser} )
